limitations: Heroes 1, 10, and 25 retain their inherited B source joins and rawRecordDirectlyInspected=false. Added directSource records preserve inspected raw fields and exact locators, not new extraction claims.

The predecessor report establishes the fixed ConfigData join claim but does not by itself establish asset bytes or extraction provenance; those are separately pinned to H-A5/H-A6 and checked against actual PNG bytes.
The historical installation packages have no recorded full-package cryptographic hash, and ConfigData/client release synchronization is not independently established.
Only the explicitly listed Hero IDs are admitted as source evidence and assets; no Hero Presentation eligibility is admitted.
